    -- ported from tests/cases/compiler/propertiesAndIndexers2.ts
    -- dropped: @target: es2015 directive (tlua defaults to latest target)
    
    interface A {
        [n: number]: string
        [s: string]: number
    }
    
    -- Lua keeps the number and string key domains distinct, so (unlike JS) tlua does not
    -- require the number indexer to be assignable to the string indexer, and a numeric key
    -- is checked only against the number indexer.
    interface B extends A {
        c: string             -- fails: string-named member vs `[s: string]: number`
        ~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property 'c' of type 'string' is not assignable to 'string' index type 'number'.
